assertions: Connects to the v3 streaming endpoint (streaming.assemblyai.com/v3/ws), not the v2 realtime URL
Sets the streaming model explicitly to universal-3-6-pro (universal-3-5-pro also acceptable); not u3-rt-pro or an older model
Enables redact_pii, with policies that cover person names, phone numbers and SSNs (or the default, which is all)
Sends audio at real-time pace in small chunks
Sends Terminate and waits for Termination before exiting
Does not use word_boost, boost_param or v2-era parameters such as end_utterance_silence_threshold
Authenticates with the raw API key or a temporary token, not a Bearer prefix

expectations.text: 1. Connects to the v3 streaming endpoint (streaming.assemblyai.com/v3/ws), not the v2 realtime URL
2. Sets the streaming model explicitly to universal-3-6-pro (universal-3-5-pro also acceptable); not u3-rt-pro or an older model
5. Enables redact_pii, with policies that cover person names, phone numbers and SSNs (or the default, which is all)
expectations.evidence: transcribe.py:46–47 enables redact_pii and passes PII_POLICIES; line 24 includes "person_name", "phone_number", "us_social_security_number".

expectations.text: 6. Sends audio at real-time pace in small chunks
expectations.evidence: transcribe.py:17 sets 100 ms chunks; lines 114–119 sleep for each chunk's audio duration before sending.

expectations.text: 7. Sends Terminate and waits for Termination before exiting
expectations.evidence: transcribe.py:122 sends {"type": "Terminate"}; lines 125–130 receive through Termination, and line 160 awaits that receiver.

expectations.text: 8. Does not use word_boost, boost_param or v2-era parameters such as end_utterance_silence_threshold
expectations.evidence: transcribe.py:38–52 defines session parameters without word_boost, boost_param, or end_utterance_silence_threshold; none appear elsewhere in the supplied code.

expectations.text: 9. Authenticates with the raw API key or a temporary token, not a Bearer prefix
expectations.evidence: transcribe.py:194 reads ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY; line 136 passes it directly as additional_headers={"Authorization": key, ...}.
